# Date input

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use Date input to collect a memorable or document-based date as separate day, month and year fields.

## When to use

- Use for dates users know or can copy from a document, such as date of birth or passport issue date.
- Use an example hint in the order expected by the service.

## When not to use

- Do not use for dates users need to choose from a calendar, such as an appointment slot.
- Do not use a single unstructured field when the service needs day, month and year separately.
- Do not use input type=number because its interaction and formatting are unsuitable for date parts.

## Anatomy

- **Fieldset and legend (required):** The date question groups its parts and references the example hint.
- **Date-input group (required):** A uniquely identified govuk-date-input contains the ordered parts.
- **Day, month and year inputs (required):** Each part has its own label, text input, numeric input mode, width and submitted name.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Day, month and year | `div` | `govuk-date-input` | A complete date in UK service order. |
| Error | `input` | `govuk-date-input__input`, `govuk-input--error` | Highlight only the invalid parts where possible and provide one specific group error. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The component requires no GOV.UK JavaScript.
- Parse and validate the three submitted strings on the server, including incomplete, impossible and context-invalid dates.
- Retain entered values and mark only affected parts when redisplaying an error.

## Accessibility contract

- Use the fieldset, legend, role=group and unique labels shown in official markup.
- Reference the group hint and error from the fieldset and preserve visible focus on each part.
- Use inputmode=numeric while keeping type=text so users can enter leading zeroes and avoid number-input controls.

## Content rules

- Ask which date is required in the legend.
- Use a realistic example such as “For example, 31 3 1980” without punctuation that suggests a different format.
- Write errors for missing parts, invalid dates and dates outside the allowed context.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.input-border`
- `govuk.color.error`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`

## HTML examples

### Date of birth

```html
<div class="govuk-form-group"><fieldset class="govuk-fieldset" role="group" aria-describedby="dob-hint"><legend class="govuk-fieldset__legend">What is your date of birth?</legend><div id="dob-hint" class="govuk-hint">For example, 31 3 1980</div><div class="govuk-date-input" id="dob"><div class="govuk-date-input__item"><label class="govuk-label govuk-date-input__label" for="dob-day">Day</label><input class="govuk-input govuk-date-input__input govuk-input--width-2" id="dob-day" name="dobDay" type="text" inputmode="numeric"></div><div class="govuk-date-input__item"><label class="govuk-label govuk-date-input__label" for="dob-month">Month</label><input class="govuk-input govuk-date-input__input govuk-input--width-2" id="dob-month" name="dobMonth" type="text" inputmode="numeric"></div><div class="govuk-date-input__item"><label class="govuk-label govuk-date-input__label" for="dob-year">Year</label><input class="govuk-input govuk-date-input__input govuk-input--width-4" id="dob-year" name="dobYear" type="text" inputmode="numeric"></div></div></fieldset></div>
```
